name: @juliuskb/opencode-voice
description: Local-first voice dictation for OpenCode with push-to-talk Whisper transcription

0.0.1: First public release of local push-to-talk dictation for OpenCode.
Added local Whisper transcription, model management, editable draft forms, settings, and recovery.
0.0.2: Fixed the TUI failing to load from a clean npm installation because the host selected the React JSX runtime.
0.0.3: Fixed the installed-package panel rendering only its initial state by shipping a precompiled reactive panel.
Added recorder cleanup/watchdogs and blocked transcription when the configured model is missing.
Aligned plugin identifiers with the published package name.
0.0.4: Added measured performance guidance and an Unload model from memory action.
0.0.5: Fixed model unload leaking native workers and memory under OpenCode's bundled Bun 1.4.2.
0.0.6: Fixed the VAD reset crash between independent takes.
Added a scrollable viewer for current and previous logs.
Model unload now closes settings and reloads cleanly on the next take.
0.0.7: Shows the installed OpenCode Voice version in the panel.
Checks daily for newer releases and announces each available version once.
Adds update availability and complete release notes without installing anything.
0.0.8: Adds an Update channel setting (Advanced → Debug): the npm dist-tag the update check follows, verified against npm when entered.
Adds an About entry to the menu with the version and the project's GitHub and npm pages.
Recommended VAD minimum silence is now 0.8 s (was 0.4), which avoids isolated one-word lines; a saved 0.4 is kept and marked with * in the menu — reset to defaults or change it yourself.

author: JuliusKB
